senses.gloss:
1. पुथ् पुथ्, i. 4, Par. To hurt, to kill.
 --Caus. पोथय.
 1. To kill, MBh. 4, 727.
 2. To bruise, 4, 643.
 3. To overpower (sound), Kathās. 34, 257. पोथित, Annihilated, MBh. 4, 795.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, Caus. To crush, Hariv. 3347.
 --With अव अव, Caus. The same, Hariv. 5611.
 --With आ आ, Caus. The same.
 --With नि नि, Caus. To strike down, Hariv. 4525.
 --With प्र प्र, Caus. To push on, Rām. 6, 25, 7.
 --With वि वि, Caus. To bruise, [] Dev. 2, 57.
 --With सम् सम्, The same, MBh. 7, 1935.
† 2. पुथ् पुथ्, i. 10, Par. To speak or shine.
